capabilities: Edit Mermaid diagrams visually through an overlay on the rendered SVG
Sprout, connect, rename and delete nodes and edges with clicks and drag-and-drop
Sync visual edits back to standard Mermaid source in the note in real time
Create and edit standalone .mmd and .mermaid files from the file explorer
Switch diagram themes via standard Mermaid frontmatter
extras: Also available for VS Code and its forks (Cursor, Devin, VSCodium) on the VS Code Marketplace and Open VSX. Only 4 of Mermaid's diagram types support visual editing; others open in a view-only mode with pan and zoom.
intentEvidence: Hover over any Mermaid block in Reading View or Live Preview and click Visual Mode
motivation: The author built it because traditional visual editors impose arbitrary spatial coordinates on Mermaid, causing broken round-trips, syntax corruption, and layout drift; Merlay instead edits structure while Mermaid computes layout.
problem: Mermaid diagrams in Obsidian are code-first, so editing them means hand-writing syntax, and traditional visual editors impose spatial coordinates that corrupt round-trips.
summary: Visual overlay editor that lets users create and edit Mermaid diagrams in notes by clicking, dragging and sprouting instead of writing syntax.
